recipe.visualDefinition: A hyper-realistic oil-painted profile of a man facing left, set against a vibrant cerulean sky filled with soft, wispy white clouds. The subject features a sharp, groomed beard and a distinct hair part, wearing a heavy gold chain, rendered with smooth transitions and a slight painterly texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool blue background
Sharp facial contours against soft, organic cloud shapes
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature and elevation
coreInvariants: Oil paint brushwork visible in skin and clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's ear and the sharp line of the beard act as the central focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the neck upward to the face, then follows the gaze toward the left edge of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper third and left side, filled with sky and clouds to emphasize openness.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and mahogany (skin tones and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky; mid-range values in the skin with soft highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to natural sky blues and earthy skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a flat brush

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the lower neck/shoulder area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom display face paired with a smaller, cleaner sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the oil painting aesthetic of the portrait.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hyper-realistic oil painting of a man's profile from the shoulders up, facing left. He has a groomed beard and a sharp hair part. He wears a thick gold chain. The background is a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. Use visible but smooth brushstrokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-painted white lettering in the bottom left corner. The text should be horizontally extended with a rough, flat-brush texture.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective a true 90-degree profile?
Is the sky a vibrant cerulean rather than a pale blue?
Does the skin have the texture of an oil painting?
Is the gold chain rendered with metallic luster?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of sky and clouds
Tangible metallic texture on the jewelry

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the profile gaze is directed off-camera to the left.
Check that the gold chain follows the contour of the neck naturally.
Verify the sky color is consistent and saturated.
Confirm the text has a hand-painted, non-digital appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Portrait + Oil Painting Medium + Cerulean Sky Background + Gold Jewelry Accent + Extended Hand-Painted Typography
